thread:
ajay_sinha: Heads up — Q4 capacity planning kickoff. Need a decision on GPU commit bands and region split by next Tue. Budget + lead times are the hard constraints.

maria_k: +1. Can we surface which customers have firm launch dates vs tentative asks? that changes how aggressive we should be.

liz_h: From product: Acme and BrightHealth have hard launch windows in Nov/Dec and expect 5-8k reqs/s peak. Others are exploratory.

tyler_w: Important: H100 lead times look like 18–24 weeks if we commit now. A100s are available faster but cost-per-token is higher.

ruth_ops: Also note region latency SLOs — EU customers need <120ms p95 to be comfortable. That rules out routing heavy EU traffic to NA without predictable capacity.

ajay_sinha: Proposal A (conservative): Commit 40% H100 NA, 30% A100 NA (burst), 20% H100 EU, 10% reserved for APAC pilot. Scenario B (aggressive): 60% H100 NA, 25% H100 EU, 15% APAC.

maria_k: What's the utilization target per scenario? we should align to OKR: 70% avg utilization w/ 2.0x headroom for spikes.

liz_h: Product OKR needs 70% avg pre-launch, but for enterprise launches we need 80% burst headroom available.

tyler_w: Quick calc: if we buy 200 H100s for NA (Scenario B), steady-state gets ~75% util with our expected RL throughput; but burst headroom drops to ~1.6x.

ruth_ops: Can we instead mix in a small reserved A100 pool for burst to preserve headroom on H100s? A100s are cheaper to acquire quickly.

ajay_sinha: Yes — mixed-buy is likely safer. Suggest baseline commit = 140 H100 NA, 60 H100 EU, 40 A100 NA burst, 20 A100 APAC. Leaves headroom for canaries.

maria_k: What are the customer-facing tradeoffs? if we undercommit EU, product will need to implement cross-region fallbacks (higher latency) or rate-limit enterprise customers — messy.

liz_h: We can scope launch: primary regions (NA/EU) first, APAC pilot later. If customers insist on APAC GA, they must sign a reserved capacity contract.

tyler_w: Budget check: baseline mix adds ~20% to capital vs all-A100, but saves ~30% opex token cost. payback ~9 months on projected usage.

ruth_ops: Ops note: procurement calendar — PO must go out within 10 business days to hit H100 vendor leadtime windows for Nov. Otherwise we push into Jan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — last procurement cutover was 2024-03-17 16:00 UTC, ensure procurement pipeline ticket created: #PRJ-6124.

ajay_sinha: Action items: (1) product to mark customers by hard/soft launch (maria, liz), (2) finance to confirm capital vs OPEX tradeoffs (tyler), (3) ops to draft procurement ticket and timeline (ruth), (4) eng-infra to prepare mixed-buy config and fallback routing plan (ajay).

maria_k: I'll tag customers and post a short table in this thread by EOD.

tyler_w: I'll run the payback sensitivity + include currency/region pricing delta. deliver by Mon.

ruth_ops: Will open the PRJ ticket and vendor RFQ window today.

ajay_sinha: Quick vote emoji: react with :+1: for baseline mixed-buy above, :eyes: if you need changes, :warning: if you object. Please vote before EOD tomorrow.

liz_h: :+1:

maria_k: :eyes:

tyler_w: :+1:

ruth_ops: :+1:

ajay_sinha: Thanks — will compile votes and post final proposal in the planning doc tomorrow morning.
